{
  "problem": "The user requests a design for a minimal REST API to manage tasks, expecting the design to be expressed in JSON structure.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define a minimal set of RESTful endpoints for task management",
    "Specify the data model for a task",
    "Specify HTTP methods, request/response formats, and status codes"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Minimal design",
    "RESTful architecture",
    "Use JSON for request/response bodies"
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "No explicit requirements for authentication, authorization, or user management",
    "No explicit requirements for persistence technology or database schema"
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What fields should a task include (e.g., title, description, completed, due date)?",
    "Should the API support filtering, sorting, or pagination?",
    "Is there a need for partial updates (PATCH) or only full replacements (PUT)?",
    "What base path should be used (e.g., /api/tasks)?"
  ],
  "raw_prompt": "Diseña una API REST minimal para gestionar tareas. Responde con estructura JSON."
}
